$schema_note: See eval/retake/README.md for the schema and the labelling rules. Every time is SOURCE-AUDIO seconds, so these labels score any backend's transcript of this file. Labelled from the transcript text of two independent readings of the same audio (mlx-whisper large-v3 re-derived 2026-10-10, parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3) and NEVER from detect_retakes output. C019 has no pinned Whisper fixture — it entered the corpus in D-377 — so there is no third reading.
what_it_is: The prompt-caching explainer. The loudest of the twelve raw sources and the first one the detector had never been tuned on (D-377): it is where Whisper over-claims too.

retakes.line: When you turn it on, after that first read, the provider hangs on to the working notes.

retakes.line: Which, to be fair, is most agents and most chatbots.
retakes.note: Whisper gives each delivery its own segment (#61, #62); Parakeet runs both inside #36. The first is arguably the cleaner read ('is' vs 'it's'), so which to keep is not obvious.

protected.note: '...changes. That's you pointing at this stack and saying everything above the line keeps it warm. Get that order right and the numbers stop being abstract. Let's actually go to the maths.' Said once. B-246's Parakeet #14 proposes cutting all of it (proposed_cuts.rs, 14.96 s).

'Around $700. Same app, same traffic, same model. About an 80% cut from one structural change.' Said once — the punchline of the worked example. B-246's Parakeet #23 proposes cutting it (12.24 s) because the segment's tail starts a false start of the next line.

'So the per-token price goes down and the monthly invoice still goes up.' Said once. B-246's one Whisper case (#50, 5.42 s) cuts it because the segment's tail, 'there's actually a name for this', repeats. The b246_tail_repeat control is this case isolated.

neutral.note: 'And it keeps them.' — the head of the same abandoned opening as c019-when-you-turn-it-on's delivery 0, re-expressed in different words as 'hangs on to the working notes'. Below the ~2 s guide on its own, but it is the first 1.5 s of a 5 s false start (whisper #0) and is not separable from it in a whisper reading.
Parakeet #31, 'in. If the' — the 'in' that closes the previous sentence and the first 'if the' false start share one 0.72 s segment, and Whisper hears no false start at all.

unlabelled_rationale: Everything inside labelled_span that is not a delivery and not neutral is unique content. Known repeats deliberately NOT labelled as deliveries, because the repeated material is a sub-segment fragment in every reading and a whole-utterance take cannot express it without taking unique speech with it (README, 'expressibility'): 'there's actually a name for this' x2 at ~322-327 s (B-246's Whisper case — both copies sit inside parakeet #27, and in whisper #50/#51 the first copy is welded to the invoice line), 'one more thing to know the notes never / one more one more thing to know' at ~255-262 s (the first is the tail of parakeet #23 / whisper #37, the second the head of #24 / #38), 'on the final bin, on the final bill' at ~293 s, 'and the input has never the / then the input was never the expensive part' at ~365 s, and the 'every / every call', 'wonder why and wonder why', 'Jevons paradox, Jevons paradox', 'prompt caching prompt caching' and 'I'm breaking, I'm breaking down' stutters.
